translations.web: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
translations.bsb: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
translations.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
translations.asv: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.
